dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, high-frequency serrated perimeters of light-intensity pixels forming closed and semi-closed loops around dark core regions; characterized by sharp binary-like transitions between dark background fur and the high-contrast ring-like boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of isolated, non-gradient high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated primarily along the dorsal ridge and the posterior transition toward the tail region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent lateral 'O' structures form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral chain oriented along the horizontal axis of the mid-body.
